_about: Natural gas bought from the network. The price comes from the block's input file (EUR per kWh of gas, lower heating value), or from price_per_kwh when the block has no file. All the CO2 of the gas burnt counts as emitted.
emission_factor_note: kg CO2 per kWh of natural gas burnt (lower heating value): IPCC 2006 Guidelines default, 56.1 t CO2/TJ. TO CHECK against the national inventory value
co2_levy_note: carbon levy per kg CO2 of the gas burnt, in the market's currency. TO CHECK: placeholder 0 (CH has a CO2 levy on heating fuels, with exemptions to check for greenhouses; FR and NL to check)
price_note: fixed gas price per kWh (market currency), used only when the block has no input file
